test_transpose: test the DataFrame transpose method returns an equal object when transposed
test_transpose_non_default_axes: test that calling transpose with non-default axes raises a ValueError
test_numpy_transpose: test numpy transpose on a DataFrame returns an equal object without axes support
test_duplicate_labels: test DataFrame transpose with duplicate index and column labels preserves dtype
test_duplicate_labels_categorical: test DataFrame transpose with duplicate labels and CategoricalDtype preserves categories
